Game Overview

Stunt Jellyfish puts players into a arcade experience centered on navigate the deep sea as a daring jellyfish in Stunt Jellyfish. Master precise moves to glide through hoops, collect sea stars, and stay alive. The stakes rise with each level, requiring timing and skill to outmaneuver challenges and ensure you gather golden jellyfish to keep swimming.
